sections.changelog:
1.9.3

Cache fix + month-scoped remove. (1) Root cause of every "update didn't take effect" report: nested module imports (`main.js → ./app.js → ./views/*.js`) carry no `?v=` cache-buster, so browsers kept serving stale JS from HTTP cache after updates — this is why 1.9.2's badge superscripts didn't appear. The service worker now fetches with `cache: 'no-cache'` (forced revalidation, cheap 304s) and `app/.htaccess` applies the same rule for non-SW traffic. ONE final hard reload (Cmd+Shift+R) is needed after this update; after that, updates propagate on a normal reload. (2) Removing a habit is now month-scoped: on the viewed sheet's month, a habit born that month (or later) is hard-deleted as before, but a habit with earlier history is RETIRED instead — `ends_on` set to the last day of the previous month, entries from the viewed month forward deleted — so deleting a July habit from the August sheet no longer touches July. Unit-tested (`remove_plan`), demo mock mirrors the server.
